# enVoy

> enVoy by weYou X is an enterprise AI patient engagement and customer communication system. It connects official WhatsApp Business API, voice AI, email, and web chat directly into hospital HMS/EMR and enterprise CRMs to automate 24/7 inquiries, appointment scheduling, reminders, and post-discharge follow-ups.

## Overview

enVoy is an end-to-end communication system deployed on official WhatsApp Business API numbers and enterprise communication channels. Rather than an isolated conversational chatbot, enVoy operates as an orchestration layer connecting customers and patients directly into live business databases, team calendars, electronic medical records (EMR), and hospital management systems (HMS/HIS).

- **Brand:** enVoy (also referred to as weYou enVoy)
- **Parent Company:** WeYouX (https://weyoux.com, India)
- **WeYouX Family Brands:**
  - **weYou enVoy:** Patient Journey & Enterprise WhatsApp/Voice communication (https://weyouenvoy.com)
  - **LegalIndia.ai:** AI Legal Intelligence & Title Diligence (https://legalindia.ai)
  - **WeYou World:** Digital Product Design & Venture Studio (https://weyouworld.com)
- **Deployment Timeline:** 7 business days from onboarding to live production
- **Channels:** WhatsApp Business API, Voice AI, Web Chatbot, Email, Mobile App
- **Language Support:** Multilingual support across Indian and global languages including English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and more with mid-conversation code-switching
- **Enterprise Integrations:** Hospital Management Systems (HMS/HIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR), CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, LeadSquared), ERPs, Google Calendar, Outlook, and payment gateways
- **Compliance & Standards:** DPDPA 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection Act India), ISO/IEC 27001 aligned security, HIPAA-grade encryption in transit and at rest, SPDI Rules (IT Act 2000), ABDM / ABHA ready architecture

## Core Capabilities

- **Intelligent Triage & Intent Recognition:** Reads patient mood, language, urgency, and history from the first message without rigid IVR menus.
- **Real-Time Availability & Booking:** Queries live doctor schedules, room inventories, and staff calendars to complete bookings in seconds.
- **Proactive Follow-Ups:** Automated appointment reminders, pre-visit instructions, queue status updates, and post-discharge recovery check-ins.
- **Human Escalation:** Seamless handover to hospital coordinators or sales agents with full conversational context when human intervention is needed.
- **Bi-Directional CRM Sync:** Writes patient details, conversation summaries, lead qualification scores, and payment confirmations back to the enterprise CRM.

## Industries Served

- [Medical Care](https://weyouenvoy.com/medical): Hospitals, multi-specialty clinics, diagnostic labs, and healthcare networks.
- [Schools & Colleges](https://weyouenvoy.com/schools): Educational institutions, universities, admissions offices, and student parent support.
- [Spas & Wellness](https://weyouenvoy.com/spas): Aesthetic clinics, luxury spas, salons, and wellness resorts.
- [Real Estate](https://weyouenvoy.com/realestate): Property developers, brokerages, and channel partners for site visit booking.
- [Resorts & Hotels](https://weyouenvoy.com/hotels): Hospitality direct reservations, guest concierge, and group inquiries.
- [Other Inbound Businesses](https://weyouenvoy.com/others): D2C brands, high-ticket retail, financial services, and professional firms.

## Healthcare Patient Journey Continuum

In hospital deployments, enVoy supports the 9 continuous stages of patient care:
1. **Patient Enquiry:** 24/7 symptom and department triage over WhatsApp.
2. **Appointment Scheduling:** Live doctor slot discovery and booking.
3. **Appointment Confirmation:** Instant calendar invite and prep details.
4. **Pre-Visit Communication:** Fasting instructions, diagnostic prep, and directions.
5. **Queue & Token Updates:** Live OPD wait-time alerts reducing waiting room congestion.
6. **Billing & Insurance Coordination:** TPA guidance, bill breakdowns, and payment links.
7. **Prescription & Reports Dispatch:** Lab results and doctor advice delivered securely.
8. **Post-Discharge Follow-Ups:** Day-3 and Day-7 medication adherence and vitals check-ins.
9. **Patient Feedback & Re-engagement:** Structured reviews, vaccination reminders, and preventive checkup scheduling.
